composition_generation.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Refine this approved Indigo Noren & warm ceramic portrait restaurant-editor concept into a more faithful fabric-and-shadow UI. Output the same ONE full portrait screen. Keep the restaurant world illustration and its arrangement unchanged; revise the UI only.

1. Bottom categories are THREE SEPARATE deep-indigo hanging noren cloth panels: People, Layout, Floor. A visible warm cedar ROD runs horizontally through two small fabric LOOPS at the top of each panel. Clear small gaps separate the three curtains, with gently rounded bottom cloth corners and subtle fabric folds. There is NO continuous dark background plate joining the curtains. Behind the hanging curtains AND their seams, one warm-cream inventory panel continues upward all the way behind the rod, so every gap reveals cream rather than the game world.
2. The category icons are single-color warm IVORY silhouettes on cloth: friendly person, BACKLESS STOOL furniture, four floor squares. No colored character portrait, blue/brown stool drawing or red icon backing. Keep a small muted-vermilion active underline for Layout only.
3. Shop is a separate soft round-ended cream PILL to the right of the three curtains, with navy basket and label. Full semicircular ends, not a rectangular card.
4. Make the inventory drawer substantially SHORTER: reduce the image sizes and show FOUR goods across: Belt (6), Stool (4), Plant (2), Crate (2). Each is a small carefully lit THREE-QUARTER product view that shows top/front/side, with a quiet cream mat, bold short navy name and neutral small quantity seal. The goods mats have NO dark outlines, only soft shallow shadows. Use narrow cream left/right paging strips at the outer edges, matching the exact mat height and material; little navy chevrons stay much quieter than the products. Each strip should be only about one-quarter of a goods mat's width. No giant framed arrow buttons.
5. Add a clearly visible slim CEDAR BOTTOM DOCK/base under the cream drawer, with a rounded edge and soft lower shadow, tying the drawer together. Keep it restrained rather than a huge wooden frame.
6. Live at upper right becomes a true VERMILION PILL with fully round ends, shorter width, compact balanced padding around its white play icon and text. Coin count and Editing label each receive matching warm-cream rounded pill backgrounds with soft shadows. The existing count and text remain.
7. The selected-item action bubble stays cream and compact with Rotate/Return. Lower its little pointer slightly so it emerges cleanly from the bottom edge, aiming at the selected stool without floating inside the capsule. Bring the bubble slightly closer to the selected object.
8. For ALL UI surfaces use SHADOW to convey separation. Remove every dark navy/brown outline, ink rim, dark bevel and hard border. Cream panel edges separate through tone and soft shadow, not dark strokes. Cloth uses subtle folds and shadows. Preserve navy TEXT and navy action glyphs, so readability remains strong.

Keep the complete calm mobile-game composition, typography hierarchy, restaurant identity and clean phone readability. No branding, game title, added settings, save/done/undo, annotation, asset sheet, frame or watermark. Exact labels are Editing, Live, People, Layout, Floor, Shop, Rotate, Return, Belt, Stool, Plant, Crate; preserve count1,240 and stocks6,4,2,2. This is the complete screen reference for a coherent reusable production UI family, not a new restaurant or a decorative moodboard.

Use case: ui-mockup production game icon sheet.
Create ONE coherent ICON FAMILY on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background for the approved Indigo Noren & warm ceramic restaurant game interface.
Reference1 is the approved complete screen: match its careful rounded silhouettes, clean dark indigo ink, warm ivory/cream on navy tabs, subtle hand-painted relief and restrained outlines.
Reference2 is the restaurant catalog for understandable icon/object identities.
Reference3 is the new coordinated SURFACE FAMILY these icons will sit on. Use its actual ivory, indigo and vermilion palette, but do not paint those panel backgrounds into the icons. Ignore any transparent-edge artifacts in the reference sheet.

Output one high-resolution SQUARE image, ideally2048x2048, EXACT4columns by4rows with equal cell sizes. Sixteen separate icons, centered one per cell in row-major order. Each icon stays inside its own cell, with at least55px transparent spacing allaround. Icons have consistent optical scale and controlled drawn contour thickness, no picture-frame or button behind them, no labels or letters. Clean genuine alpha outside the silhouettes. No background, no black board or checker pattern, no ornamental shadow blobs, watermarks, titles, grid, numbers or registration marks. No loose speckles outside the icons.

ROW1 left-to-right:
1 PEOPLE: charming cream head/bust with simple indigo hair/face accents and clear friendly silhouette, like approved People tab.
2 LAYOUT: a simple readable CREAM BACKLESS STOOL with a chunky seat and two/four short legs, thin indigo contour. A furniture pictogram, NOT a torii gate or building.
3 FLOOR: FOUR small cream square floor tiles in a2x2 square, fine dark indigo gaps/rims. Screen-aligned squares, not diamonds.
4 SHOP: deep indigo basket with a handle, filled bold silhouette with three cream cutout slats.

ROW2:
5 ROTATE: one bold dark-indigo curved three-quarter circular arrow with a clear arrowhead, like approved action bubble.
6 RETURN TO INVENTORY: bold dark-indigo OPEN STORAGE BOX with an arrow pointing DOWN INTO IT. Retain object in storage, no trash or delete bin.
7 LEFT CARET: broad clean dark-indigo left chevron with gently rounded ends.
8 RIGHT CARET: matching broad clean dark-indigo right chevron.

ROW3:
9 COIN: golden warm illustrated coin, fine dark rim and simple star emboss, restrained bright top and lower shading, crisp at smallscale.
10 CLOSE: thick dark-indigo X with rounded ends.
11 RETRY: dark-indigo circular-arrow retry symbol, clearly legible.
12 WARNING: muted vermilion exclamation inside a fine triangular outline, cream small interior, no text.

ROW4:
13 PLAY: simple warm-IVORY filled right-pointing triangle, thin quiet dark-red edge suitable on primary vermilion button.
14 POINTER: a small downward-pointing triangular CREAM speech-bubble TAIL with a fine INDIGO outline along its two sloping sides, OPEN/UNOUTLINED top edge. Plain, shallow triangle, no whole bubble behind it. It will attach to a separate cream action capsule.
15 EDIT: deep-indigo chunky pencil, diagonally tilted, clear simple form.
16 CHECK: bold deep-indigo check mark with rounded ends.

The family should look bespoke and commercial, consistent with the complete restaurant UI, using clean silhouette design and sparse highlight/shadow detail. No 3D photographic lighting, shiny gold glyphs everywhere, generic thin vector line icons, gradients across transparent regions, or arbitrary new visual motifs.

authoring_notes: Exact source rectangles with no repaint, thresholding, alpha edits, resampling or rescaling. Transparent four-pixel atlas gutters are separate. Symmetric source and logical slices preserve undistorted corners and hanging loops. Original Floor/coin retain v5 source pixels and complete historical provenance. Rounded pill surfaces have a 100-logical-pixel minimum height, at least their full source height at the calibrated corner scale; the centre must never collapse into pointed ends.
